messages:
Aisha: Quick sync — ACME deployment scheduled Thu 2026-03-26 14:00 UTC. Need final quota, autoscale policy, and a shadow load probe window. @Marco can you confirm steady-state QPS target?
Marco: Target from product is 1200 QPS steady, 3k burst for 5m. We'll do a 10% canary first. :thumbsup:
Priya: Renewal note — customer expects <100ms p95 for short responses; flagging as a renewal risk if dry run misses it.
Ethan: Infra update: reserved pool currently 8 A100s (32GB). Recommend GPU pinning + prewarmed KV cache. I can bump to 10 GPUs for first 24h if we want extra headroom.
Aisha: Proposed autoscale config (draft):
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 4
  max_replicas: 12
  scale_policy:
    - metric: p95_latency_ms
      target: 90
      window: 30s
    - metric: cpu
      target: 70
      window: 60s
```
Marco: Change request — use 60s window for p95 to reduce flapping. Also add CPU as secondary signal.
LoadBot: scheduled shadow probe 2026-03-26T14:00Z -> 15:00Z, script=qps-burst.json, ramp=5m, hold=20m, decay=5m.
Aisha: Example load payload (abbreviated):
```json
{
  "targets": [{"model": "gptx-large", "qps": 1200}],
  "seq_len": 64,
  "payload": "Hello there",
  "concurrency": 400
}
```
Priya: Request — add two customer-specific prompt cases to the script (one short chat, one long-form summarization) so we capture p95 across shapes.
Ethan: Will add KV warmers and GPU pinning. ETA: change deployed to staging by Wed 18:00 UTC.
Aisha: Action items:
- @Marco: adjust autoscaler window to 60s + confirm canary cutover plan
- @Ethan: confirm GPU bump + KV warmers deployed to staging
- @Priya: schedule enablement session (45m) + collect 2 priority prompts from ACME
- @LoadBot: run shadow probe and upload artifacts to s3://redwood-acme/shadow/1768429999/
Priya: I'll mark account health = amber and note renewal risk in the QBR doc. I'll also run the enablement invite once Ethan confirms Fri 10:00 PT availability.
Marco: I'll post the dry-run dashboard link when metrics start flowing: https://dash.redwood.internal/acme/dryrun/1768429999
Aisha: Thanks — regroup after probe and decide whether to keep the GPU bump for the first 72h. :rocket:
